svg.title: FailureCast end-to-end execution flow
svg.desc: Dataset import, asynchronous training, human model release, prediction behavior, and independent failure outcomes.
svg.text: The implemented path from validated import to an explicitly approved model and API-backed engine estimates.
train + test + RUL for one FD001-FD004
test engine count matches RUL labels
An identical import reuses its version
Write to staging, then atomic directory rename
Only the committed version is selectable
Training runs outside the HTTP request
Final artifact refit on all train engines
Candidate is not active by default
A tracking warning does not stop a
Official test labels are used only in the
SQLite state; browser advances by request / response
moved files; duplicate hash is reused
MLflow warning does not fail training
Invalid report or no approval leaves
candidate inactive and current model intact
Operational scope: one API process + one worker on a single host; no message broker or multi-host coordination is present.
